implementation.before: Settings repeat17 arbitrary CSS-variable color recipes across six model-profile files.
implementation.after: The same existing profile/theme owners are expressed by five named semantic aliases; no new color, layout, state or API behavior.
implementation.compiledContract: Independent actual app/library proof covers all five aliases, including hover and scoped selector/declaration/layer contracts; attached proof has10 app/library contracts.

before.production: Real production Local Canvas, Agent Server1.58.1, automation1.25.1, --mars-web, installed Google Chrome in owned private profile. No route interception, DOM mutation, frontend mocks or source edits.
before.profiles: Empty state, Custom create helpers, save valid QA-only router with classifier free text and no provider connection, list/menu/Edit/Cancel. Add Models Moonshot keyless chooser; select all enables Add and clearing disables Add. No model validation, completion or bulk-profile creation.
before.files: Actual owned Markdown bytes served from real workspace via an idle offline conversation, zero messages and no model calls. Rich/Plain toggle, prose-invert in dark themes, semantic descendant colors, native horizontal table scrolling and inherited fade.
before.phone: 390x844 actual settings forms and dedicated /panel route. Initial file-tree-open narrow preview excluded from publication in favor of follow-up native Hide file tree captures. No phone layout change claimed.
before.media: Original PNG/MP4 retained;25fps normal action timing, no speed or pixel-identity claim. Recorder trims still lead-in and adds final hold.

after.production: Real production Local Canvas, Agent Server1.58.1, automation1.25.1, --mars-web, installed Google Chrome in owned private profile. No route interception, DOM mutation, frontend mocks or source edits.
after.profiles: Empty state, Custom create helpers, save valid QA-only router with classifier free text and no provider connection, list/menu/Edit/Cancel. Add Models Moonshot keyless chooser; select all enables Add and clearing disables Add. No model validation, completion or bulk-profile creation.
after.phone: 390x844 actual settings create/edit/list/menu and keyless chooser. Inherited narrow form layout is unchanged; only visibly shown areas claimed.
after.media: Original PNG/MP4 retained;25fps normal action timing, no speed or pixel-identity claim. Recorder trims still lead-in and adds final hold.

scope.mainFilm: Genuine standalone Local UI, selected observed paths only; actual source crops follow full viewport context.

comparisonSummary: 23 matched computed state sets, all equal within the documented measured contract; 0 unpaired states explicitly disclosed. No global pixel identity or performance claim.
limits: Appearance-preserving refactor. Native captures compare the specified exact source revisions and named observed paths, without global pixel identity, exhaustive UI coverage or performance claims.
Both Before and After styles are compiled CSS; no inline-style migration is claimed.

Selected complete originals retain existing timing and bytes. The recorder caps still lead-in and holds its final frame; source clock/misses are preserved. Editorial still holds and actual crops are explicitly labelled, with full context before detail.
Five built-in themes have representative stills, plus390×844 phone views; no claim of every state/theme/viewport combination.
No model prompt, completion or agent turn was run. No real provider credential, paid resource, webhook delivery or automation dispatch was used.
Library/host CSS contracts are compiled evidence; live capture uses standalone Local Canvas only.
Known Solarized Light keyless helper contrast issue #18546 remains. These edits preserve existing values and do not claim a readability/contrast fix.
Cloud organization, unsupported older-backend and bound-provider connection branches are not live coverage; static compiled contracts cover the aliases.
The standalone Add Models body portal is inside the scoped body. Embedded-host Add Models portal behavior remains an existing separate coverage gap; no live embedded claim.
Keyless Moonshot selection only enables/disables Add. No bulk profiles were created, model validated or completion requested. The QA-only router is saved but never executed.
